title: RideFlow — Event-Driven Distributed Backend Simulation
description: A backend system simulating a ride-hailing platform using event-driven architecture and asynchronous service communication, designed to model scalable distributed systems.
results: Designed an event-driven architecture to simulate real-world distributed systems with loosely coupled services
Implemented asynchronous workflows and inter-service communication patterns to improve scalability and resilience
Modeled complex system interactions such as ride requests, matching, and state transitions across services
Explored microservices design trade-offs including service boundaries, communication overhead, and fault tolerance
Built a system focused on scalability concepts rather than simple request-response APIs
